The new Synaptics Astra SR200 Series of AI-native MCUs combines 400 GOPS of AI inference with Arm® Cortex®-M85 and Cortex®-M52 cores. Powered by Synaptics Torq™ with Google Research’s Coral NPU™, SR200 enables low-power multimodal AI for wearables, connected cameras, and industrial systems. Integrated vision, display, and audio pipelines support Edge and physical AI applications.
